scoring.prediction_rule: target claim has conflict Issue => conflict; else target claim has insufficient_evidence Issue => insufficient_evidence; else no_conflict
scoring.retrieval: all expected evidence semantic targets appear in the target claim retrieval top 5
scoring.cited_evidence_precision: all cited Evidence rows resolve to current-project SourceSpan and match expected evidence for the evaluated target claim
scoring.expected_evidence_recall: for conflict cases, unique cited expected Evidence divided by all expected direct Evidence
scoring.multi_direct_evidence_full_set_recall: share of requires_multiple_direct_evidence conflict cases citing the complete expected Evidence set
scoring.conflict_category_accuracy: share of expected conflict cases whose predicted category equals expected_category
scoring.designated_category_mismatch_regression: all three cases tagged category_mismatch_regression must predict the declared category
scoring.cost: unavailable when Provider does not return cost; never estimate

stability_protocol.selection_rule: first by case_id among designated regressions, no_conflict, insufficient_evidence
